people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.
translations.bsb: Solomon replied to God: “You have shown much loving devotion to my father David, and You have made me king in his place.
translations.kjv: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
translations.asv: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast showed great lovingkindness unto David my father, and hast made me king in his stead.
